excluded.name: Colorado River: Hoover Dam to Willow Beach (Black Canyon Water Trail, NV/AZ border)
excluded.reason: NPS: Launching at the Hoover Dam (river mile 64) requires a permit. Paddlecraft can launch and takeout at Willow Beach. The Hoover launch is permit/outfitter-controlled, the reach is the NV/AZ border, and the candidate USGS gauges checked gave no recent discharge. Willow Beach NPS POI 20605 (35.86795, -114.66259) was found but not reviewed. Best done with a Nevada package.

excluded.name: Colorado River: Topock Gorge (Havasu NWR, AZ/CA border)
excluded.reason: FWS: launching at either Topock Marina in Arizona or Park Moabi in California. Topock Marina is a private marina and Park Moabi is in California; FWS gives no coordinates. These boat launches do not provide access to the Colorado River. (Topock Marsh launches). No live gauge found.
